category_title: Pre-engaged students with organizational and focus challenges
minimal_context: The student is participating in a whole-class literacy lesson at the beginning of the school year with the goal of seeing themselves as a reader.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright everyone, it is time for our whole-class literacy lesson. Please sit and listen to the instruction so we can practice seeing ourselves as readers.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I came to school to learn!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: That is great. Now please focus on what I am saying.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Wiggles around and points at a neighbor) Look at what he is doing.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please keep your eyes up here and listen to the lesson.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Picks up a found piece of string from the floor and starts twisting it around his fingers, completely fascinated by it instead of the teacher)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Alright everyone, it is time for our whole-class literacy lesson. Please sit and listen to the instruction so we can practice seeing ourselves as readers.

STUDENT: I came to school to learn!

TUTOR: That is great. Now please focus on what I am saying.

STUDENT: (Wiggles around and points at a neighbor) Look at what he is doing.

TUTOR: Please keep your eyes up here and listen to the lesson.

STUDENT: (Picks up a found piece of string from the floor and starts twisting it around his fingers, completely fascinated by it instead of the teacher)

task.content: listening to teacher instruction during whole-class literacy lessons
task.learning_goal: getting them comfortable with the idea of…. see[ing] themselves as readers

context.environment: full day of instruction at the beginning of the school year
context.materials: A found piece of string, window
context.social_setting: whole-class literacy lessons, fellow students, neighbors, friends, audience

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: A found piece of string, what a fellow student is doing, a bird flying by the window
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: become more fascinating than what the teacher is saying

behavior_patterns.condition: If you ask them why they came to school
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: they say, 'to learn,' even though they don't initially know exactly what that entails.
